definition: what is still live toward Nick, and how I set the dose when I see him

settled:
My brother is Nick. The question on its own brings a stress response and sadness and grief close to tears, and I almost never cry.

We hosted him and his girlfriend at Thanksgiving. I managed polite, and I had trouble regulating for part of the night.

Hosting is what makes seeing him affordable. It gives me a room to retreat to and a way to leave early without hurting anybody.

My plan for a family gathering is to keep the time around people small: come when it is time to eat and otherwise stay out of it.

If I were healthier, with my safety higher and the multiplier lower, I would consider more deliberate contact for the exposure it buys. Where I am now, minimal is the right call.

title: Where Things Are With My Brother
